subject: Immunization
title: India National Immunization Schedule: The Logic of Age-Based Prevention
preview: Understand birth doses, infant primary series and boosters while checking the current official Indian UIP schedule.

sections.title: Recognize the schedule structure
points: The routine schedule combines birth, early infant, later infant and childhood booster visits rather than a single uniform interval.
JE and certain other vaccines may depend on program or geographical eligibility.

sections.title: Safety and administration
points: Document vaccine, batch, route, site and prior doses; use the exact formulation-specific instructions.
Temperature excursions require a documented cold-chain response instead of assuming stock remains potent.

sections.title: Exam trap — do not memorize an outdated chart
points: Schedules, product presentations and state-specific implementation can be revised; check the current Ministry of Health/National Health Mission guidance.
A delayed series generally needs an appropriate catch-up plan, not indiscriminate restarting.

quickRevision: At birth, the national program includes BCG, oral polio birth dose and hepatitis B birth dose.
Primary infant vaccination follows age-appropriate schedules and formulation-specific rules.
Catch-up vaccination depends on valid previous doses, age, risk and the latest official guidance.
